verdict.rationale: The professional section of impots.gouv.fr links to 'Payer en ligne' and to a professional-space login, and its FAQ covers accessing and paying CFE/IFER notices, including by direct debit. That shows a core tax transaction (payment) can be completed online per the service's own pages. However, the evidence is mostly navigation-link titles rather than procedural documentation. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that business tax returns (e.g. VAT/corporate tax) can be filed online through the espace professionnel, step-by-step first-party documentation of the online payment flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
